relevance_rank_note: Directly measures B2 (sortilin recycling, biotinylation) and endosomal retention of the apoE-sortilin complex (PLA with transferrin) for apoE4 vs apoE3, but in hamster CHO cells overexpressing murine sortilin with exogenous HEK-secreted apoE, and it measures no binding affinity itself (it states equal binding, citing earlier SPR).

description: Surface-biotinylated sortilin was allowed to internalise and then recycle (dynasore-blocked re-uptake, GSH stripping) in the presence of apoE3 or apoE4; about half as many receptors recycled to the surface with apoE4 (49.56 +/- 16.92% vs 100 +/- 13.84% of apoE3).
quote: In these studies, the amount of receptors recycling back to the cell surface was reduced by 50% in apoE4-treated as compared to apoE3-treated cells (Figures 6D, E).
summary: (apoE3 -> apoE4) -> (less sortilin recycled to the cell surface)
system: Chinese hamster ovary (CHO) cells stably overexpressing murine sortilin (CHO-S); human myc-tagged apoE3 or apoE4 secreted by transfected HEK293 cells, 5 ug/mL in medium; surface sortilin biotinylated at 4 C, 15 min internalisation at 37 C with apoE, 60 min recycling at 37 C with dynasore, GSH stripping, streptavidin pull-down and western blot densitometry; recycled fraction = internalised minus remaining intracellular, apoE3 mean set to 100%.
human_check: Class 3: recycling block (B2) measured without binding (B1). The paper states 'Both apoE variants interact with sortilin equally well, as shown previously using surface plasmon resonance analysis' (ref 19); that equal-binding claim is cited, not measured here, so it is not a row, but it argues against the 'adheres more tightly' half of H4 for sortilin. Single star on the apoE4 bar, legend key *P<.05 (Student's t test). n = 9 biological replicates from three independent experiments.

description: Sortilin-apoE complexes detected by proximity ligation assay colocalised more with transferrin-marked early endocytic/recycling compartments when cells were treated with apoE4 than with apoE3, measured as thresholded Manders' tM1 (transferrin to PLA).
quote: Colocalization of receptor/ligand complexes in Tf-positive cell compartments was significantly higher in apoE4 as compared with apoE3 treated cells as shown by Manders’ values tM1 (C) and tM2 (D).
summary: (apoE3 -> apoE4) -> (more sortilin-apoE complex retained in transferrin-positive endocytic/recycling compartments)
system: Chinese hamster ovary (CHO) cells stably overexpressing murine sortilin (CHO-S); human myc-tagged apoE3 or apoE4 secreted by transfected HEK293 cells, 5 ug/mL for 2 h, then Alexa Fluor 647-transferrin 25 ug/mL for 20 min; proximity ligation assay with anti-sortilin and anti-myc; thresholded Manders' tM1 per cell.
human_check: Effect read off bars: tM1 apoE3 ~0.08 vs apoE4 ~0.145. ** on panel, legend key **P<.01. n is cells (15-18 per condition), not independent cultures. Borderline class 1: the PLA signal is the apoE-sortilin complex itself, retained in Tf-positive compartments, which is close to the class 1 wording 'retention of ApoE together with the receptor in endosomes measured as a complex'; kept class 3 because it is an imaging colocalisation fraction, not an amount of bound complex, and the authors frame it as trafficking 'rather than binding'.

description: Same proximity-ligation experiment quantified the other way (thresholded Manders' tM2, PLA to transferrin): a larger fraction of sortilin-apoE complexes sat in transferrin-positive compartments with apoE4 than with apoE3.
quote: The extent of co-localization of sortilin/apoE complexes (PLA signal) with Tf was significantly higher with apoE4 as compared with apoE3 (Figure 5C, D).
summary: (apoE3 -> apoE4) -> (larger fraction of sortilin-apoE complex in transferrin-positive endocytic/recycling compartments)
system: Chinese hamster ovary (CHO) cells stably overexpressing murine sortilin (CHO-S); human myc-tagged apoE3 or apoE4 secreted by transfected HEK293 cells, 5 ug/mL for 2 h, then Alexa Fluor 647-transferrin 25 ug/mL for 20 min; proximity ligation assay with anti-sortilin and anti-myc; thresholded Manders' tM2 per cell.
human_check: Effect read off bars: tM2 apoE3 ~0.165 vs apoE4 ~0.27. Single * on panel, legend key *P<.05. Same cells as Fig 5C (two Manders coefficients of one experiment), so not independent of the 5C row. Same class 1 vs 3 borderline as 5C.

description: Internalisation of surface-biotinylated sortilin over 15 min did not differ between apoE3 and apoE4 treatment (apoE4 bar slightly higher, about 110% of apoE3), so the apoE4 effect was confined to the recycling step.
quote: The detrimental effect of apoE4 was specific for the recycling step of the sorting path as the extent of internalization of sortilin (Figure S5B) or its ligand apoE (Figures S5C, D) was not different comparing apoE3 and apoE4 treatment conditions.
system: Chinese hamster ovary (CHO) cells stably overexpressing murine sortilin (CHO-S); human apoE3 or apoE4 secreted by transfected HEK293 cells, 5 ug/mL; surface biotinylation at 4 C, 15 min internalisation at 37 C, GSH stripping of surface label, streptavidin pull-down and western blot densitometry, percent of apoE3.
human_check: Null for internalisation (text: 'not different'); no P printed, no star. Effect read off the supplement figure (apoE3 100%, apoE4 ~110%). Against for an uptake surrogate only; it does not contradict the recycling result in Fig 6E.

description: Uptake of apoE itself into sortilin-expressing CHO cells over 30 min did not differ between apoE3 and apoE4 (apoE4 about 105% of apoE3 by western blot densitometry).
quote: the extent of internalization of sortilin (Figure S5B) or its ligand apoE (Figures S5C, D) was not different comparing apoE3 and apoE4 treatment conditions
summary: (apoE3 -> apoE4) -> (no change in apoE internalisation via sortilin-expressing cells)
system: Chinese hamster ovary (CHO) cells stably overexpressing murine sortilin (CHO-S); human apoE3 or apoE4 particles secreted by transfected HEK293 cells, 30 min at 37 C; internalised apoE by western blot with GAPDH and sortilin as controls, densitometry as percent of apoE3.
human_check: Null for apoE ligand uptake; no P, no star. Effect read off S5D (apoE3 100%, apoE4 ~105%, wide spread). n = 6 biological replicates from two independent experiments comes from the supplement legend (PDF page 9 screenshot), which is not in ft/32588544.txt. S5C is the representative blot, S5D the quantification; one measurement, cited as one row.
